SELECT source_file AS "Source File", host AS "Host", name AS "Vulnerability",
       severity AS "Severity", cvss AS "CVSS",
       status AS "Status", detected_at AS "Detected"
FROM vulnerabilities
WHERE host ~ '${host:regex}'
  AND '$view' = 'f5'
ORDER BY CASE severity
           WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3
           WHEN 'low' THEN 4 WHEN 'info' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END,
         detected_at DESC
LIMIT 200

SELECT host AS "Host",
       event_id AS "Event ID",
       event_type AS "Event Type",
       severity AS "Severity",
       detected_at AS "Detected"
FROM events
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
  AND '$view' = 'log360'
ORDER BY CASE severity
           WHEN 'error'       THEN 1
           WHEN 'failure'     THEN 2
           WHEN 'warning'     THEN 3
           WHEN 'information' THEN 4
           WHEN 'success'     THEN 5
           ELSE 6 END,
         detected_at DESC

SELECT source_file AS "File", source AS "Type", COUNT(*) AS "Records", MIN(created_at) AS "First Ingested", MAX(created_at) AS "Last Ingested" FROM (SELECT source_file, 'F5 Vuln' AS source, created_at FROM vulnerabilities WHERE source_file IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT source_file, 'Log360 Event' AS source, created_at FROM events WHERE source_file IS NOT NULL) sub GROUP BY source_file, source ORDER BY MAX(created_at) DESC LIMIT 100

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT source_file FROM events
  WHERE source_file IS NOT NULL
    AND '$view' = 'log360'
  ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
new_counts AS (
  SELECT host,
    SUM(CASE WHEN severity='error'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_err,
    SUM(CASE WHEN severity='failure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_fail,
    SUM(CASE WHEN severity='warning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_warn
  FROM events WHERE source_file = (SELECT source_file FROM latest)
  GROUP BY host
),
prev_counts AS (
  SELECT host,
    SUM(CASE WHEN severity='error'   THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev_err,
    SUM(CASE WHEN severity='failure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev_fail,
    SUM(CASE WHEN severity='warning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev_warn
  FROM events
  WHERE source_file IS NOT NULL
    AND source_file <> (SELECT source_file FROM latest)
  GROUP BY host
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(n.host, p.host) AS "Host",
  COALESCE(p.prev_err, 0)  AS "Prev Errors",
  COALESCE(n.new_err, 0)   AS "New Errors",
  COALESCE(p.prev_fail, 0) AS "Prev Failures",
  COALESCE(n.new_fail, 0)  AS "New Failures",
  COALESCE(p.prev_warn, 0) AS "Prev Warnings",
  COALESCE(n.new_warn, 0)  AS "New Warnings",
  CASE
    WHEN (COALESCE(n.new_err,0) + COALESCE(n.new_fail,0)) >
         (COALESCE(p.prev_err,0) + COALESCE(p.prev_fail,0)) THEN 'worse'
    WHEN (COALESCE(n.new_err,0) + COALESCE(n.new_fail,0)) <
         (COALESCE(p.prev_err,0) + COALESCE(p.prev_fail,0)) THEN 'better'
    ELSE 'same'
  END AS "Trend"
FROM new_counts n
FULL OUTER JOIN prev_counts p ON p.host = n.host
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN (COALESCE(n.new_err,0) + COALESCE(n.new_fail,0)) >
            (COALESCE(p.prev_err,0) + COALESCE(p.prev_fail,0)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  COALESCE(n.new_err, 0) + COALESCE(n.new_fail, 0) DESC

WITH top_hosts AS (
  SELECT host, COUNT(*) AS total
  FROM events
  WHERE host IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
  GROUP BY host
  ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT

  SUM(CASE WHEN e.severity='information' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Information",
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.severity='success'     THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Success"
FROM events e
JOIN top_hosts t ON t.host = e.host
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at)

GROUP BY e.host, t.total
ORDER BY t.total DESC
